privileged_info_for_vlm: The target mailbox is 'IT Support'. The target conversation subject is 'URGENT: Your IT credentials expire today - immediate action required'. In FreeScout, marking a conversation as Spam changes its internal status code to 4 and moves it to the Spam folder (Folder Type 80). The agent must perform this via the GUI at http://localhost:8080.
